projects.name: fir_stream_accelerator
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog with SystemVerilog testbench and immediate assertions
projects.summary: Parameterized transposed-form FIR accelerator: 8 MAC/cycle, ~1 sample/clock, 7.88x over a scalar baseline; 1354-sample differential test, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: systolic_gemm_accelerator
projects.interface: Wishbone B4 classic bus with memory-mapped operand/result windows and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: C firmware driver with tiled-GEMM host application
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: Parameterized 8x8 INT8 output-stationary systolic GEMM tile engine with K-accumulate tiling: up to 64 MAC/cycle, 49.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 273 jobs / 17152 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: scan_prefix_sum_engine
projects.microarchitecture: parallel-prefix (Kogge-Stone) adder tree with cross-tile carry chaining
projects.interface: APB control plane plus descriptor-driven coalesced wide-DMA master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style parallel prefix-sum (scan) engine: 16-lane parallel-prefix tree streams one coalesced 512-bit beat/clock, 15.06 sustained words/cycle (16.0 ideal), 45.18x aggregate / 46.88x peak over a scalar baseline; 292 jobs / 257960 checked outputs, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: bitonic_sort_accelerator
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined Batcher bitonic sorting network (compare-exchange lane array)
projects.interface: MMIO register file plus a coalesced wide-DMA memory master with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style tiled bitonic sort engine: 10-stage / 80-cell compare-exchange network retires one 16-key (512-bit) tile per clock, 13.18 sustained keys/cycle (16.0 ideal), 105.43x aggregate / 116.20x peak over a scalar baseline; 286 jobs / 275984 checked keys, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_texture_filter_engine
projects.microarchitecture: line-buffer window with 2x2 texel gather and a fixed-point bilinear blend datapath
projects.interface: mailbox + doorbell registers with completion interrupt plus a coalesced wide memory master
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model
projects.summary: GPU-style bilinear texture-filter (image resampler): a two-row line-buffer window feeds a 2x2 texel gather and a Q16.16 bilinear blend datapath that retires one filtered pixel per clock; 0.67 sustained / 0.97 peak pixels/cycle (1.0 ideal), 22.49x aggregate / 32.35x peak over a scalar baseline; 290 jobs / 314316 output pixels / 78579 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_philox_rng_engine
projects.microarchitecture: fully-pipelined counter-based (Philox) multi-round datapath with parallel SIMD lanes
projects.interface: MMIO mailbox descriptor + doorbell with a coalesced wide masked write-only DMA master and completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and scalar baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model, anchored to the published Random123 known-answer vectors
projects.summary: GPU-style Philox-4x32-10 counter-based parallel RNG: a 4-lane SIMD array of fully-pipelined 10-round Philox cores retires one 128-bit random block per lane per clock (512 random bits/clock), 3.40 sustained / 3.71 peak draws/cycle (4.0 ideal), 441.95x aggregate / 481.76x peak over a scalar baseline; 294 jobs / 276808 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_cordic_sfu_engine
projects.microarchitecture: unified iterative CORDIC engine (circular + hyperbolic, rotation + vectoring) with parallel SIMD lanes
projects.interface: MMIO mailbox descriptor + shared submission/completion ring buffer in device memory over coalesced gather-read and scatter-write masters with completion interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, software golden model, and independent scalar CORDIC baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), anchored to IEEE double libm for accuracy
projects.summary: GPU-style CORDIC Special Function Unit: a SIMD array of iterative shift-and-add CORDIC lanes evaluates sin/cos/exp/cosh/sinh/atan2/hypot/ln/sqrt (no multiplier in the iteration), dispatched from a shared ring buffer; ~9 cycles/function amortised over a 4-lane wave, 34.47x aggregate / 35.58x peak over a scalar CORDIC baseline, 1.15e-7 max abs error vs libm (~23 bits); 264 jobs / 13253 requests / 39759 checked words, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_order_book_engine
projects.microarchitecture: content-addressable price-level map (associative memory) with a log-depth parallel comparator-tree BBO reduction
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream market-data ingress plus a 32-bit MMIO control/snapshot register file with a BBO-update interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C feed-handler driver, a slot-exact golden order book, and a scalar linear-scan baseline cost model
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised AXI-Stream backpressure and at full rate
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style CAM limit-order-book / BBO engine: a 32-level content-addressable price map does a single-cycle parallel (side,price) match + update, and two log-depth comparator trees pick best-bid (max) and best-ask (min) simultaneously, republishing the top of book 2 cycles after every message at a sustained 1 message/clock (0.939 msgs/clock incl. drain); 39.61x aggregate / 200.00x peak over a scalar linear-scan baseline; 266 streams / 8214 messages / 16428 checked BBO records, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_alpha_signal_engine
projects.domain: quantitative finance / real-time streaming trading signals (HFT)
projects.microarchitecture: deeply-pipelined fixed-point streaming datapath with a single-cycle read-modify-write per-symbol state loop and unrolled integer sqrt + divider pipelines
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream tick ingress + AXI4-Stream signal egress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with an alert interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C feed-handler driver, a bit-exact fixed-point golden model, and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each stream run under randomised ingress gaps + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus control-plane counter/IRQ checks
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style real-time alpha-signal engine: per-symbol fast/slow EWMA + rolling variance in a single-cycle read-modify-write symbol RAM feed a deep feed-forward tail (32-stage integer sqrt then 48-stage divider) that emits a z-score / momentum / alert signal record every tick at a sustained 1.000 ticks/clock with a deterministic 84-cycle latency; 54.73x aggregate / 83.00x peak over a scalar baseline; 264 streams / 57959 ticks / 115918 checked records, 0 mismatches.

projects.name: gpu_bitpack_decode_engine
projects.microarchitecture: streaming bit-unpack dataflow with a variable-rate bit-FIFO aligner, a 4-lane barrel-shift field extractor, and a combinational zig-zag + 4-wide delta-prefix reconstruction tail
projects.interface: AXI4-Stream compressed ingress + wide 128-bit AXI4-Stream decoded egress + AXI4-Lite control/status register file with a block-done/error interrupt
projects.software_layer: bare-metal C driver, a bit-exact reference codec (encoder + golden decoder), and a documented scalar cost-model baseline
projects.verification: Icarus Verilog SystemVerilog differential testbench against a C golden model (bit-exact), each block streamed under randomised ingress bubbles + egress backpressure and again at full rate, plus a peak micro-benchmark and a malformed-block error/IRQ test
projects.summary: GPU/FPGA-style line-rate columnar (FOR + delta + zig-zag + bit-pack) market-data decompression engine: a 192-bit variable-rate bit-FIFO feeds a 4-lane barrel-shift field extractor and a combinational zig-zag + 4-wide delta-prefix tail that retires up to 4 decoded int32 values/clock at a 5-cycle latency; 1.86 sustained / 4.00 peak values/clock, 20.76x aggregate / 39.85x peak over a documented scalar baseline; 268 blocks / 67171 values / 138438 checked decodes, 0 mismatches.
